issues.description: Top nav wraps to three lines (Kaomoji/Fancy Text/Blog on row 1, Tools/Collections on row 2, Platforms on row 3) which pushes the page content down and looks visually unbalanced. Functional but not polished.
Same nav wrapping issue as other pages — header consumes ~3 rows on mobile.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.

Mobile collapses to a single-column grid for 24 arrow cards, producing an extremely tall page (~4500px). Pi/Copyright/Degree pages use the same single-column treatment but with fewer items so it isn't as painful. Two columns on mobile would cut scroll length in half.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.

Compared to peer single-symbol pages (checkmark, degree, copyright, infinity, pi), this page has only an intro + grid. No 'How to Type' / keyboard shortcuts section and no internal-linking pills (e.g., Hearts, Aesthetic Text, Emoji) at the bottom. Also no Unicode codepoint labels under each card unlike sibling pages.
Same thin-content issue as desktop — no shortcuts, no related-category links, no codepoints.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.

Two cards both labeled 'Eight Pointed Star' (positions 11 and 14 in the grid: U+2738 ✸ vs U+2734 ✴) — identical names will confuse users. Disambiguate the labels (e.g., 'Eight Pointed Black Star' vs 'Eight Pointed Pinwheel Star') or merge.
No 'How to Type' / shortcuts section, no internal linking pills, no Unicode codepoint labels under cards. Inconsistent with checkmark/degree/copyright pages.
Same duplicate 'Eight Pointed Star' label issue as desktop.
Same thin-content issue as desktop.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.

Classic Emoticons cards display the emoticon as the large character AND repeat it as the label below (e.g., ':)' as the symbol with ':)' as the label, 'xD' / 'xD', 'T_T' / 'T_T'). Reads as redundant since there's no extra info — a description like 'happy smile' or 'crying' would be more useful.
No 'How to Type' shortcuts section and no internal linking pills (would expect links to Kaomoji, Lenny Face, Emoji).
Same emoticon symbol/label redundancy as desktop.
Same site-wide mobile nav wrapping issue.

Circled-Numbers cards repeat the symbol in both the large display and the label (e.g., '①' big and 'Circled ①' beneath; same for ②–⑳). Suggest replacing label with the plain integer ('Circled 1', 'Circled 2', ...) so the label adds disambiguating information rather than echoing the glyph. Same mild redundancy on Roman/Superscript sections.
No 'How to Type' / shortcuts section, no internal linking pills (Math Symbols, Pi Symbol, Greek Letters would be natural). Inconsistent with peer pages.
Same Circled-Numbers symbol/label redundancy as desktop.
Same missing shortcuts + internal linking as desktop.
Single-column grid for 60+ cards yields an extremely tall page (~9000px). Two columns would help.
